profile.headline: Software Engineer at PSI
profile.summary: After years in the construction, casino, and restaurant industries I decided to pursue my love for technology and attend Centriq Training to find a career in the development field. During my time at Centriq I received several peer recommended awards and completed their training with their career ready approval.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.locationName: Overland Park, Kansas, United States · On-site

positions.title: Dump Truck Operator / Heavy Equipment Mover
positions.description:
Complete daily safety inspections on equipment and submit any damage to the shop supervisor to schedule repairs.
Coordinate with job site foreman to get current dumpsites and load sites for current job.
Adjust routes and job sites on the fly as needed when problems arise.
Coordinate daily with equipment supervisor to create a schedule and route for equipment relocation and document all pick-up and drop off locations and equipment ID numbers.
Log all fuel receipts, off site repair tickets and end of day documentation and turn in all paperwork to supervisor at the end of shift.

positions.title: Brake Press Operator
positions.description:
Complete daily safety and calibration inspections on 48 ton brake press and correct any calibration errors to ensure accurate and uniform press operations.
Translate length and angle measurements from blueprints to manual entry brake press programmer.
Check for uniformity and accuracy in all pre-cut material pieces before beginning order production.
Adjust various press attributes on the fly to correct any issues in product output.
Log all progress, problems or shortages in plant computer database.

positions.title: Mixer Truck Operator
positions.description:
Complete daily safety inspections on equipment and repair any worn or damaged parts as necessary.
Service and maintain mixer trucks when required.
Safely operate mixer trucks to and from dispatched client locations.
Perform plant maintenance and repairs when necessary.
Record and accurately log all fuel use and daily receipt transactions.
Accurately log daily mileage as per DOT regulations.

positions.title: Vactron Operator
positions.description:
Locate and visually identify underground utilities using hydro excavation equipment.
Prepare daily route and plan of action from utility company blueprints.
In charge of 1 – 3 subordinates on crew.
Interpret and follow all SOP’s and safety guidelines and ensure subordinates do as well.
Maintain and repair Vactron equipment as necessary.
Log and file all progress with foreman as work progresses such as any unmarked utilities, total utilities located and corrections or modifications made to existing blueprints.
Log all fuel receipts and pass any equipment expenditures to accounting office for purchase tracking.
Meet daily with general foreman and project engineers to go over blueprints and site maps for upcoming projects. 
Coordinate and communicate with other vac and bore crews in the area to ensure daily projects are done without overlap or wasted time.
Communicate with property owners to ensure they are aware of our presence and purpose and keep them up to date on any safety hazards present while on site.

positions.title: Flatbed Delivery Driver
positions.description:
Perform pre-shift inspections of all equipment and appliances being delivered.
Plan out daily delivery routes for all products being delivered and review plan of action with other drivers.
Log and properly dispose of any hazmat items encountered during shift in accordance to EPA guidelines.
Assembly and testing of store merchandise before it is put on display.
Safe operation of all powered equipment inside of store and on site such as a fork lift, order picker, scissor lift or tow behind fork truck.
Log all delivery results at end of day and when necessary, reconcile anything issues with management at the store or regional level.
Use store customer database to track and retrieve any additional information needed about customers or products.
Periodically communicate with other drivers throughout the day to check progress in routes and troubleshoot any problems that arise either by phone or on site if necessary.

positions.title: Front of the House Manager / Bartender
positions.description:
Supervise up to 10 servers, bar backs and hostesses.
Schedule weekly shifts for front of the house employees on a bi-weekly basis.
Inventory and reorder all beers, liquors and garnishes through multiple vendors while staying within weekly budget allotments.
Address and accommodate any customer complaints as they arise.
Program and price all new drink and food offerings in point of sale system.
Train front of the house staff on operation of point of sale system and company policies.
Handle end of shift tip out with all servers at the end of their work shift.
Expedite all drink orders in a timely fashion to keep dining room flowing smoothly.
Keep bar and dining area clean and clutter free both for customers and health department inspections.
